name: Incremental Tensor Reconstruction
definition: A reconstruction method that computes the outer-products of basis matrices and core tensor entries incrementally by rearranging the summation order to reduce computational complexity from O(R1·R2·R3·I1·I2·I3) to O(R1·I1·I2·I3).
summary: Incremental Tensor Reconstruction is a volume reconstruction method that reduces computational complexity by rearranging summation order to minimize floating-point operations, distinguishing itself from partial decoding by focusing on algebraic rearrangement rather than skipping data blocks.
